items.title: MEK1/2 Signalling establishes an alloreactive effector T cell program through SMAD4 during cardiac allograft rejection
items.description: CONCLUSIONS: MEK1/2 signalling regulates T cell activation and effector phenotypes via SMAD4 nuclear translocation in heart transplant rejection. Therapeutic intervention targeting this pathway may contribute to alloimmune response regulation and improve transplant outcomes.
items.conclusion: MEK1/2 signalling regulates T cell activation and effector phenotypes via SMAD4 nuclear translocation in heart transplant rejection. Therapeutic intervention targeting this pathway may contribute to alloimmune response regulation and improve transplant outcomes

items.title: Anatomically Defined Motor Phenotypes Reveal Dissociated Trajectories of Progression, Neurofilament Profiles, and Survival in ALS
items.description: CONCLUSIONS: Anatomically defined motor phenotypes identify reproducible ALS trajectories with distinct clinical and neurofilament profiles. Early propagation provides an actionable risk marker of disease aggressiveness, while combined upper and lower motor neuron dysfunction or lower motor neuron predominance is prognostically unfavorable. These findings support integrating structured phenotyping into prognostic models and clinical trial stratification.

items.title: CSF and plasma lipid profiling predicts risk of cognitive impairment in cognitively unimpaired older adults
items.description: INTRODUCTION: Age-related cognitive decline and Alzheimer's disease (AD) are strongly influenced by lipid metabolism, yet how central and peripheral lipid profiles relate to disease risk before symptom onset remains unclear.

items.description: CONCLUSIONS: U.S. HIV testing and linkage-to-care initiatives rely on multi-component implementation strategies centered on training, workflow/site reconfiguration, and clinician-facing supports, while adjunctive interventions chiefly target recipient capability and motivation. items.title: Diagnostic evaluation of long-read nanopore sequencing for pediatric CNS tumors
items.description: Long-read nanopore sequencing enables methylation-based CNS tumor classification while providing additional genomic information within a single assay. However, its performance across molecular features relevant to pediatric CNS tumor diagnostics and across available methylation classifiers remains incompletely characterized. items.title: Breaking the Silence: A Mixed Methods Analysis Unveiling Barriers to Mental Health Service Use in Breast Cancer Survivors With Clinically Significant Distress
items.description: CONCLUSIONS: Few clinically distressed breast cancer survivors utilize MHS. Anxiety, depression, and PTS symptoms may better predict MHS use than FCR, potentially due to avoidant coping among fearful survivors. Interventions targeting avoidance, alongside survivor-informed improvements in mental health care delivery, may enhance MHS access and outcomes.
items.conclusion: Few clinically distressed breast cancer survivors utilize MHS. Anxiety, depression, and PTS symptoms may better predict MHS use than FCR, potentially due to avoidant coping among fearful survivors

items.description: INTRODUCTION: Plasma β-synuclein is a promising blood-based synaptic biomarker, but relationships with synaptic density as indicated by [^(11)C]UCB-J positron emission tomography (PET), and blood biomarkers of Alzheimer's disease (AD) pathology, neurodegeneration, and astrocyte activation need further characterization.

items.description: CONCLUSIONS: The data suggest a possible link between polyreactivity and anti-MDA/MAA autoreactivity in RA-DLBCL lymphomagenesis. items.title: Can blind box buying be addictive?: Measurement and associations with gambling disorder among Chinese adults
items.description: CONCLUSIONS: The current study is the first exploratory investigation of problematic blind box buying and its relationship with GD. It provides evidence for the validity and reliability of PBBS for measuring problematic blind box buying. Moreover, its findings also support the addictive potential of blind box buying and the associated risk with gambling disorder. These findings provide practical insights for the regulation and policy of blind box commerce and GD intervention.
items.conclusion: The current study is the first exploratory investigation of problematic blind box buying and its relationship with GD. It provides evidence for the validity and reliability of PBBS for measuring problematic blind box buying

items.title: Piezo1-mitochondrial calcium uniporter coupling-dependent mechanotransduction basis for acupuncture to drive analgesia
items.description: CONCLUSION: Piezo1 acts as a core peripheral mechanotransducer that converts local mechanical stimuli generated by acupuncture into downstream analgesic signaling in CFA-induced inflammatory pain. This study delineates a specific myocyte-originated mechanotransduction axis underlying acupuncture analgesia under inflammatory conditions, thereby providing mechanistic insights for understanding acupoint-specific therapeutic effects.

items.description: T cell-mediated autoimmune diseases remain difficult to manage owing to limited options and adverse effects of current immunosuppressants; safer, tolerance-preserving approaches are needed. items.title: Quercetin attenuates maternal respiratory virus-induced fetal neuroimmune dysregulation
items.description: CONCLUSION: These findings identify maternal NK cell-derived granzyme B as a central driver of respiratory virus-induced fetal neuroimmune disturbance and support quercetin as a dual-action immunomodulatory candidate capable of mitigating maternal immune dysregulation and fetal neuroinflammation.
items.conclusion: These findings identify maternal NK cell-derived granzyme B as a central driver of respiratory virus-induced fetal neuroimmune disturbance and support quercetin as a dual-action immunomodulatory candidate capable of mitigating maternal immune dysregulation and fetal neuroinflammation

items.description: CONCLUSIONS: PACG-associated ALCs show a distinct molecular signature characterized by impaired proteostasis and ATP6V1A-associated lysosomal dysregulation. items.description: Rapid-eye movement sleep deprivation (REM SD) has controversial effects on behavioral functions and cognitive abilities. Recent evidence has shown that REM SD in rats may lead to manic- and obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD)-like behaviors. items.description: CONCLUSION: KHSRP drives PCa progression through a DUSP6-dependent signaling axis by repressing DUSP6 at the post-transcriptional level and facilitating coordinated activation of ERK and PI3K/AKT/mTOR signaling. items.description: CONCLUSIONS: These findings identify a BTBD9-IMPDH2-adenosine pathway that links human genetic risk to basal forebrain control of sleep homeostasis. items.title: Tracing-based drawing method enhances anatomy learning outcomes and proportional awareness: a randomized cross-over study
items.description: CONCLUSION: TBDM was associated with higher drawing performance and more positive learner ratings than TMBM. A positive method contrast was observed at both the immediate and one-week delayed assessments, although the difference was smaller at the delayed assessment. TBDM may provide a low-cost, structured complement to existing anatomy-learning methods. Its longer-term and transferable educational effects require further investigation.

items.description: CONCLUSIONS: Tumor-informed ctDNA monitoring was feasible in 70% of screened patients and showed high concordance with radiologic disease assessment in this real-world sarcoma cohort. items.title: Preliminary Investigation of Maternal and Offspring Genetic Effects of the DBH Gene in Probands with Schizophrenia and Their Relatives
items.description: CONCLUSION: This pilot study suggests a potential maternal genetic effect of DBH rs5320 in schizophrenia. However, these preliminary findings require validation in larger and more complete family-based samples.

items.description: Nardostachys jatamansi has traditionally been used to treat gastrointestinal disorders. items.title: Updated guide to the assessment of mammalian cellular senescence
items.description: Cellular senescence is a stable cell cycle arrest, which has a crucial role in organismal aging and many chronic diseases. Here, we present an updated MiniResource that extends the methods for mammalian senescence assays, including analyses of cell cycle arrest and cellular morphology, changes in transcriptomic signatures, and fluorescence-based tools. This work will provide practical guidance to help researchers design appropriate experiments for assessing cellular senescence.

items.description: Arterioles are the principal regulators of vascular tone, yet their small size and deep tissue location hinder direct investigation of their roles in microvascular disease. To address this, we developed a human microphysiological arteriole distinguished from previous models by simultaneously integrating an arteriole-scale caliber (~200 μm), continuous perfusion culture, and active vasoactivity. items.description: Precise control of trap states in amorphous dielectrics requires identifying the fundamentally different physical origins of hole and electron trapping. items.description: Wearable electrical stimulation (ES) devices are emerging platforms for wound healing, where cellular responses at the skin-electrode interface critically influence therapeutic outcomes. items.description: Ultrathin Pt-based 2D alloy nanosheets are promising electrocatalysts for the oxygen reduction reaction (ORR) due to their high surface-to-volume ratios and favorable facet-dependent activity. items.description: Recognizing a swarm of unmanned surface vehicles does not guarantee that its physical cardinality can be recovered. items.title: Nutrient Sensing, Monitoring, and Control for Hydroponic Crop Production in Smart Greenhouses
items.description: Hydroponic crop production in smart greenhouses requires accurate nutrient monitoring and reliable control, especially in recirculating systems. This review critically examines sensing principles, data acquisition, control strategies, actuation, feedback, and system integration. Electrical conductivity (EC) and pH are widely used for dosing, but EC cannot quantify individual nutrient concentrations. items.description: Measuring torsional movement is crucial for tracking human kinematics in applications such as virtual reality, biomechanics, rehabilitation, and soft robotic joints.
